Of Broadwindsor, Dorset, the earliest Hutchins in the line.
He married Agnes Orchard on 17 January 1572 and then Alice on 5 June 1588, and children were baptised to him from
1594 to 1601, the last of them Mathew. A birth year of 1532 would make him 69 at that baptism,
so he was more likely born about 1545 to 50.
